apps.name: Arcade Box
apps.pitch: Run quick actions on files, media, and text
apps.tagline: File, media, text, web and system tasks in one searchable desktop tool.
apps.description: Arcade Box brings file, media, text, and system tasks into one searchable action surface. Choose an input, run a tool, and use or save its result.

apps.name: Arcade Clipboard
apps.pitch: Keep clipboard history in sync across devices
apps.tagline: An encrypted copy history, synced across your own devices.
apps.description: Arcade Clipboard stores a history of copied text, links, images, and files and syncs it between your paired devices. Pairing uses a QR code, and clips are encrypted on each device.

apps.name: Arcade Find
apps.pitch: Find files by name or content
apps.tagline: Press a shortcut, type, and any file or folder shows up.
apps.description: Arcade Find indexes file names and metadata so you can search without waiting for a full disk scan. When ripgrep is installed, you can also search inside files.

apps.name: Arcade Lens
apps.pitch: Select a screen area and act on it
apps.tagline: Select anything on screen and act on it.
apps.description: Arcade Lens lets you select an area of the screen and recognizes text, QR codes, colors, and other useful details. It offers actions for the selection without making you choose a separate tool first.

apps.name: Arcade Look
apps.pitch: Preview files without opening another app
apps.description: Arcade Look shows a quick preview of documents, media, images, folders, archives, and other files. Press Space on a selected file to see it, then open or act on it if needed.

apps.name: Arcade Shelf
apps.pitch: Keep files and notes close while you work
apps.tagline: A floating workspace for desktop content.
apps.description: Arcade Shelf holds references to files, folders, links, and text in a small desktop workspace. Organize items into shelves, then drag them or send them to another app.

apps.name: Arcade Wheel
apps.pitch: Launch apps and actions with a radial menu
apps.tagline: A radial launcher for the desktop. Hold a key, flick toward an action, release.
apps.description: Arcade Wheel opens a radial menu while you hold a global shortcut. Move toward an action and release, or use a center gesture to run a group.

tools.name: Arcade Tools
tools.tagline: The optional home for the Arcade apps.

bundles.title: Essentials
bundles.description: Search, preview, and collect the files you use every day.

bundles.title: Screen and capture
bundles.description: Capture screen details, work with results, and keep clips close.

bundles.title: Everything
bundles.description: Install every app in the Arcade catalog.
